subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should native `openclaw backup create` add pattern-level exclusion now, and what default, ignore-file, and protected-path semantics must the linked implementation satisfy before merge?
rationale: The missing CLI surface is clear, but the permanent behavior controls archive contents and security-sensitive recovery data, and the open implementation candidate already carries unresolved proof and merge-risk signals.

options.title: Review and narrow the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 as the implementation path after resolving proof, protected-path, external-asset, and default-loading semantics.

options.title: Define the native contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify the backup filtering contract, then ask for a smaller PR against that contract.

options.title: Defer native support
options.body: Keep third-party recovery plugins as the workaround and close or pause native exclude support only after maintainers explicitly reject core backup filtering.

recommendation.title: Review and narrow the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 as the implementation path after resolving proof, protected-path, external-asset, and default-loading semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the initial backup CLI and contributed backup path-helper work, which is the closest current history signal for this product/security choice.
